'''Chapter 1042''' is titled "The Victor Needs No Epithet".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 6: "Take Niji and Yonji to Whole Cake Island"

[[Charlotte Oven|Oven]] takes the book containing [[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]] and [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]] through a [[Mirro-World|mirror]].

==Short Summary==
[[Luffy]] and [[Kaidou]] battle ferociously, with Luffy only having time for a few more attacks before his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques|Gear 4]] expires. However, the head of the [[CP0]] convoy, following a brief struggle with [[X Drake]] who performed a last-ditch attack, then arrives at the dome roof whilst Luffy is preparing his final attack. His arrival distracts Luffy, resulting in Kaidou hitting him with a devastating strike, and this causes Kaidou to recall [[Kurozumi Higurashi]]'s interference in his fight against [[Kouzuki Oden]] 20 years ago.

==Long Summary==
[[X Drake]] has stabbed the [[CP0]] agent [[Guernika]] from behind. As he coughs up blood, the agent asks Drake why he is interfering with him, and Drake answers that it is because he follows his own justice. Guernika tells Drake he envies him before using '''Shigan''' on his throat to break free.

In the [[Flower Capital]], the people are writing wishes and setting them adrift in the sky in their sky lanterns, while on the roof of [[Onigashima]], [[Kaidou]] is continuously pummeled by [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s attack, and when he blocks one punch, he gets hit in three more spots. He admits his attacks are hurting him as he realizes that Luffy is altering the trajectory of his punches at whim. He once again tells him his attacks hurt as he goes into '''Amae Jogo''', which angers Luffy at the fact that he is still drunk. Kaidou then goes into '''Nusubito Jogo''' mode and transforms into his [[Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu|full dragon form]] to finally escape Luffy's onslaught, where he then bites and swallows Luffy. Kaidou flies up into the air and once he is high enough, he opens his mouth, letting Luffy fall, but also firing '''Bolo Breath''' at him, the attack piercing straight through the island and blowing Luffy down through the hole.

Luffy, however, escapes the blast and changes into '''Boundman''' to fly back up to him. He declares that this is his last '''Gear 4''', and he no longer has any time to waste to beat him. He yells to Kaidou that the people of [[Wano Country|Wano]] will continue to starve and go thirsty as long as he remains just as he prepares to use the move '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques#Boundman 2|Gomu Gomu no Over Kong Gun]]'''. As for Kaidou, he tells Luffy that while it is his business who he teams up with, he personally considers the people of Wano weak and used to defeat, citing the samurai as "losers" who would willingly die for the sake of "honor". Luffy retorts that the samurai are strong, but Kaidou rejects this notion as he prepares another '''Bolo Breath''', but Luffy fires his attack first causing Kaidou to misfire in his mouth and crash to the ground.

Luffy charges at him again but Kaidou quickly gets back up and hits him with '''[[Hassaikai#Techniques|Horai Hakke]]''', causing Luffy to crash. Steam starts to eject from his mouth, but Luffy tries to force it in as Kaidou goes into his '''Satsuriku Jogo''' mode. Both charge at each other once again with '''Gomu Gomu no Over Kong Gun''' and '''Horai Hakke''', but Guernika finally arrives and grabs Luffy's arm, using '''Tekkai''' in the process to hold him back. Though Kaidou sees the agent too, he is unable to stop himself from striking Luffy while the agent steps back, causing Kaidou to flashback to when [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] was distracted by [[Kurozumi Higurashi]] during their fight, as a look of horror is shown in his eyes.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[X Drake|Drake]] attacks [[Guernika]].
**The agent survives the attack and retaliates with [[Six Powers/Shigan|Shigan]].
*[[Toko]] prepares a [[Fire Festival|sky ship]] lantern.
*The fight between [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Kaidou]] continues.
**Kaidou can use advanced [[Haki/Observation Haki|Observation Haki]].
**Luffy is shown to be able to shift between [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques|Gear 4]] forms.
**As the two prepare to attack each other, Guernika arrives and holds Luffy back.
***The distraction reminded Kaidou of how his fight against [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] was interrupted by [[Kurozumi Higurashi|Higurashi]].
***As a result, Luffy takes Kaidou's attack head-on, while Kaidou himself looks on in shock.
